normalized_rule: Brihat Jataka gives the exaltation degrees as Sun in Aries at 10°, Moon in Taurus at 3°, Mars in Capricorn at 28°, Mercury in Virgo at 15°, Jupiter in Cancer at 5°, Venus in Pisces at 27°, and Saturn in Libra at 20°.
synthesis_notes: This is a Brihat Jataka/Varahamihira rule, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: The seven planet/sign/degree assignments are retained as one cohesive table; the source does not establish a universal ayanamsha for the degrees.
